newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Greenpeace says it blocks Swiss nuclear waste.
newsitem.headline: Greenpeace says it blocks Swiss nuclear waste.

text.p: Around 20 Greenpeace activists blocked two trucks they suspected of carrying nuclear waste from a Swiss power plant for reprocessing in France or Britain, the environmentalist group said on Tuesday.

It said it staged the protest in Val de Travers, near Fleurier in the western Swiss canton of Neuchatel, to press its demands for an end to reprocessing of nuclear fuel, which it said was polluting the world's oceans.
It also called on the Swiss government to refuse to let any more nuclear waste leave the country.
"We want the trucks to return to (Swiss nuclear utility) Muehleberg and not leave Switzerland," Greenpeace co-ordinator Stegfan Fueglister said by telephone from the scene.
Local police said they were discussing with Greenpeace how to end the blockade.
